text: 9月11日至14日，2026浦江创新论坛（第十九届）在上海举办。中国科学技术发展战略研究院党委书记刘冬梅在论坛期间发布《中国区域科技创新评价报告2026》。报告显示，我国区域科技创新水平持续提升，上海综合科技创新水平保持全国第一，江苏、浙江、安徽均进入全国前十。长三角在研发资源、财政科技投入、创新产出等方面，主要指标值占全国比重均超过30%，已成为我国最具活力的区域创新高地之一。（证券时报）
text_en: From September 11 to 14, the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum (19th session) was held in Shanghai. Liu Dongmei, Party Secretary of the Chinese Academy of Science and Technology for Development, released the "China Regional Science and Technology Innovation Evaluation Report 2026" during the forum. The report shows that China's regional science and technology innovation level continued to improve, Shanghai maintained the top national ranking in comprehensive science and technology innovation level, and Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Anhui all entered the national top ten. In the Yangtze River Delta, the share of major indicators in research and development resources, fiscal science and technology investment, and innovation output all exceeded 30% of the national total, making it one of China's most dynamic regional innovation highlands. (Securities Times)
